history.alt_text: A garage-wall modular steel lock-latch and open inspection gate with an interlocking bay rail under left-sided directional light.
history.caption: The image shows a latched modular gate on a garage wall, where the rate benchmark, not the equity pile, decides what a homeowner can reach.
history.title: Locked Equity Rate Latch Assembly

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: A left-lit modular lock-latch assembly on a garage wall: two interlocking brushed-steel latch plates, one latched shut across a vertical seam, one hinged inspection gate swung partway open beside a recessed connected bay rail. Deep graphite and ochre against bone-white painted drywall, hard clean edges, one directional light from the left throwing long cast shadows across brushed steel and weathered concrete. Asymmetric two-thirds framing, lock-latch off-centre left, generous negative space to right, no text, no logos.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, watermarks, labels, embossed lettering, printed numbers
rationale: The story turns on a single benchmark gate and a reclassification rule, not a physical product, so a restrained modular assembly of latch, gate, and bay captures the locking mechanism without overstating a real facility. Component assembly also keeps the required home-site material world and one-directional light.
subject: a lock-latch assembly and open inspection gate on a garage wall
core_thesis: The record $11.6 trillion of accessible home equity becomes locked when the floating mortgage benchmark moves to 7.18%, leaving only homeowners priced at or above market able to tap equity without penalty.
core_conflict: A cheap fixed first-mortgage lock versus a floating market benchmark that reclassifies equity as locked without any change to the house.
composition: asymmetric two-thirds rule with lock-latch off-centre left
alt_text: A brushed-steel lock latch and its open inspection hatch set in a weathered white wall, one leaf swung wide.
caption: Home Equity Stuck At 7.18%: The record $13.2T home equity moves when rates move, not when a homeowner decides.
title: Home Equity Stuck At 7.18%

review.depicts: A brushed-metal lock-latch plate and a small hinged inspection-hatch door mounted in an opening on a painted, weathered white wall, with a vertical seam running down the wall to the left of the hardware.
review.reason: The latch-and-open-hatch assembly is the article's own lock-in mechanism made literal — locked equity with a small reachable opening — rather than a different industry or protagonist, though it is a generic hardware metaphor rather than a housing-finance object.
